observations.observation: IdempotencyKey renders operation_type:service:deterministic_hash. Validates nonempty service, at least 8 hash characters, and alphanumeric/hyphen/underscore service characters. generate_deterministic_hash uses normalized payload SHA-256 with a default 12-character hex prefix. This is observed implementation, not proof of collision freedom.

IdempotencyRequest/IdempotencyResponse are local Pydantic models. Request key minimum length 10; timeout default 300 seconds, accepted range 1..3600. Response statuses are pending, in_progress, completed, failed and expired. These defaults are not the MT4 acknowledgement timeout.

Helpers construct order, signal and risk-validation keys from normalized inputs. should_retry returns true only for FAILED responses below max_retries (default 3) that are not expired. This helper does not prove exactly-once execution, persistence, locking or broker duplicate suppression.
